name: Worldforged Thunderstomp Scale stands on Un'Goro terrain under the fallen log (#13420)
contract: #13420 reported the Thunderstomp Scale pickup (Preserved Dermal Plate, gameobject entry 95918, guid 6942322, drops item 515372) in Un'Goro Crater underground and unclickable. The realm-map pass moved (x, y) 6.17 yd north-east to (-7821.700, -917.400) where terrain is -268.4505 while keeping the old z (-269.053), burying it 0.60 yd underground. rev_20261126_13420 restores first-pass realm-dump row 6901316 (-7823.470, -923.311, -269.053; +0.075 yd above .map terrain -269.128), tucked under the overhanging flank of Ashenvaletreelog02.m2 (ID 183066, underside at -267.650, +1.403 yd above the pickup). Because ProbeTerrain queries Map::GetHeight from z + Z_OFFSET_FIND_HEIGHT (+2.0 yd), its downward ray hits that overhanging log surface and spawn_ground_gap reads -1.403 against the log rather than the terrain; do not assert spawn_ground_gap/spawn_placement here. Expected: the pickup stands at (-7823.470, -923.311, -269.053) under the log overhang (headroom ~1.10 yd vs 10.0 yd on the bare slope), is not under water, and opens with loot from open ground 1.60 yd away (6.51 yd from the broken spot).
